answer: The bridge window is stated at settlement, ferrous lists reopened cases, and summit records every clawback. A farmer's realised profit is as a result provisional, and cashing out early does not protect it because the liability follows the identity through every checkpoint. Settlements stay reversible for 56 epochs: a later audit that finds a settled answer was plagiarised or machine-spammed claws back the payout from the original recipient. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
